english.title: Parent of child of compulsory school age registered at a school who failed to attend regularly
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) you were the parent of **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE CHILD..) a child of compulsory school age, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AGE..), who was registered at **(..SPECIFY THE SCHOOL..) and failed to attend regularly at that school
english.legislation: Contrary to section 444(1) and (8) of the Education Act 1996.

english.notes:
(i) See Sections 1(3), (5) and (6) for exceptions in respect of a child who is not a border at the school at which he/she is a registered pupil.
(ii) See Section 1(7) for proceedings in respect of a child who is a border at the school at which he/she is a registered pupil.
(iii) Section 444(6) provides that proceedings must be instituted by the Education Authority
